rows.name: EXPORT_ONLY

problems.statement: It does not start the ingest program and does not update the model config file.
problems.code_says: `build-all.sh` adds `--no-config` for every model that has an architecture name, and every registry model has one. So `build-model.py` never updates the config file in a `build-all.sh` run, with or without `EXPORT_ONLY`. The sentence names a change that the variable does not cause.

problems.statement: writes the trace (the PyTorch export of the model)
problems.code_says: The option help of `build-model.py` calls the output the model trace. The document uses the bare word trace for a Perfetto recording, and the other ingest rows say model trace.

cells.Values and default: Any non-empty text turns it on. The script does not parse the text. The value `0` also turns it on. Unset: off. The script does not add `--export-only`.
cells.Effect: `build-all.sh` (the script that runs ingest for the models listed in `config/models.yaml`) adds `--export-only` to every `build-model.py` call. `build-model.py` then writes the model trace (the PyTorch export of the model) and stops. It does not start the ingest program (the Haskell executable `ingest`) and generates no Tron model code. `build-model.py` then does not read `GHC`, `CABAL_INSTALL` or `CABAL_FLAGS`. `DUMP_ALL` has no effect.

rows.name: GHC

cells.Set by: The Nix dev shell sets `ghc`. CMake sets it for child commands.
cells.Values and default: Name or full path of the GHC program (the Haskell compiler). CMake does not accept a directory. Unset: CMake searches only for `ghc` and its fixed `ghc-<version>` names. `build-model.py` uses `ghc`. Empty: `build-model.py` passes an empty `-w` value.
cells.Effect: It selects the compiler of the Haskell program `ingest`. CMake configure tries the value as its last candidate name. A fixed name that CMake finds takes priority over the value. Without `IN_NIX_SHELL`, configure stops unless the compiler reports the version pinned in `README.dependencies.md`. `build-model.py` passes the value to `cabal run` as the compiler option `-w`. It reads `GHC` only without `--ingest-bin` and `--export-only`.

rows.name: NO_META

cells.Values and default: Any non-empty text turns it on. The script does not parse the text. The value `0` also turns it on. Unset: `build-all.sh` adds `--meta-device` to every `build-model.py` call.
cells.Effect: `build-all.sh` (the script that runs ingest for the models listed in `config/models.yaml`) leaves out `--meta-device`. rows.name: TRON_MODEL_CACHE_LEASE_FDS

cells.Values and default: File descriptor numbers separated by white space. Each item is parsed with `int`. An item that is not an integer raises `ValueError` and ends the script. Unset: `build-model.py` passes no extra file descriptor to the export process.
cells.Effect: `build-model.py` passes the listed file descriptors to the process that exports the model trace (the PyTorch export of the model). Each descriptor is a lease (an open file that holds a shared lock in the CI model weights cache). `prepare_tests.py` sets the variable only when it runs a command after `--`. It passes the same descriptors to that command. A process that did not inherit these descriptors cannot use the numbers. `build-model.py` does not read the variable when the option `--skip-export` is given.
